props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// ONI Custom Event Helper (emit) – minimal inline version

// This makes ONI.emit(eventName, payload) available if it isn't already.

// ============================================================================

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

// Default: LOCAL ONLY (perfect for UI-ish things like animationStart/End)

ONI.emit = function(eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

// When you REALLY want to broadcast something across all clients

// (e.g. game-state changes, global cutscene flags), use this:

ONI.emitWorld = function(eventName, payload = {}) {

Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

if (!ONI._worldRx) {

ONI._worldRx = (data) => {

if (!data?.action) return;

Hooks.callAll(data.action, data.payload);

};

game.socket.on("world", ONI._worldRx);

}

console.log("[ONI Events] Helper installed.");

}

/**

* JRPG Melee Attack Template – Foundry VTT v12 + Sequencer + JB2A

* (with oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd events, and footsteps ON)

*/

// Foundry VTT v12 + Sequencer + JB2A

// Selected token runs near the targeted token, slashes with SFX, then runs back.

// Uses instant horizontal flip (doc.update + animate:false) with extra timing gaps.

// Now also shows a dummy floating damage number (9999) via Sequencer .scrollingText.

// ALSO: broadcasts oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd via ONI.emit (LOCAL ONLY).

(async () => {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

return ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

}

const sourceToken = canvas.tokens.controlled[0];

const targetToken = Array.from(game.user.targets)[0];

if (!sourceToken) {

return ui.notifications.warn("Select a token first.");

}

if (!targetToken) {

return ui.notifications.warn("Target a token first (use Foundry's targeting system).");

}

// --- DEBUG: macro start --------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI AttackDemo] START",

"source:", sourceToken.name, `(${sourceToken.id})`,

"target:", targetToken.name, `(${targetToken.id})`,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Broadcast: Animation START (LOCAL ONLY) ----------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "meleeAttack",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenId: targetToken.id,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- Tunables -----------------------------------------------------------

const runDuration = 500;

const gridSize = canvas.grid?.size ?? 115;

const stopOffset = gridSize * 0.8; // distance to stand from the target

const preReturnFlipDelay = 200; // ms after slash before first flip

const flipBackDelay = 500; // ms after arriving home before flipping back

const hitSound = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/HitSlashM.wav";

const footstepSound = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_FootStepNormal_1.ogg";

const jb2aFile = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group02/TrailAttack02_01_02_Regular_OrangeRed_800x600.webm";

// --- Helper: play looped footsteps for a certain duration ---------------

function playFootsteps(durationMs) {

const interval = 120; // time between steps (ms)

const maxSteps = Math.ceil(durationMs / interval);

let count = 0;

const timer = setInterval(() => {

if (count >= maxSteps) {

clearInterval(timer);

return;

}

AudioHelper.play(

{

src: footstepSound,

volume: 0.7,

autoplay: true,

loop: false

},

true // broadcast to all connected users

);

count++;

}, interval);

}

// --- Helper: instant horizontal flip using your document method ---------

async function flipTokenInstant(token) {

const doc = token.document;

const tex = doc.texture ?? {};

const currentScaleX = (typeof tex.scaleX === "number") ? tex.scaleX : 1;

const targetScaleX = -currentScaleX;

await doc.update(

{ "texture.scaleX": targetScaleX },

{ animate: false } // no tween; instant flip

);

}

// Remember original position (top-left doc coords so Sequencer can bring us back)

const originalPos = {

x: sourceToken.document.x,

y: sourceToken.document.y

};

const sourceCenter = sourceToken.center;

const targetCenter = targetToken.center;

// Decide which side to stand on: left or right of the target

const attackerIsLeft = sourceCenter.x < targetCenter.x;

const attackPos = {

x: targetCenter.x + (attackerIsLeft ? -stopOffset : stopOffset),

y: targetCenter.y

};

// --- DEBUG: before main Sequence ----------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI AttackDemo] Playing main Sequence",

"JB2A file:", jb2aFile,

"runDuration:", runDuration,

"attackPos:", attackPos,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- 1) Run forward + attack (with footsteps) ---------------------------

playFootsteps(runDuration);

await new Sequence()

// Run up to a position BESIDE the target (no rotation)

.animation()

.on(sourceToken)

.moveTowards(attackPos)

.duration(runDuration)

.snapToGrid()

.waitUntilFinished()

// Play hit SFX around the time of impact

.sound()

.file(hitSound)

.delay(500)

.volume(1)

// Dummy damage number "9999" using Sequencer's scrollingText

.scrollingText()

.delay(650)

.atLocation(targetToken, { randomOffset: false })

.text("9999", {

fill: "#FFFFFF",

fontSize: 40,

fontWeight: "bold",

lineJoin: "round",

strokeThickness: 4,

stroke: "#000000"

})

.duration(1000)

// Slash effect on the target

.effect()

.file(jb2aFile)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(0.5)

.rotate(90)

.waitUntilFinished()

.play();

// --- DEBUG: after main Sequence completes -------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI AttackDemo] Main Sequence complete for",

sourceToken.name, "->", targetToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- 1.5) Small pause after the attack before flipping to "run back" ----

if (preReturnFlipDelay > 0) {

await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, preReturnFlipDelay));

}

// --- 2) Instant flip BEFORE running back --------------------------------

await flipTokenInstant(sourceToken);

// --- 3) Run back (with footsteps) ---------------------------------------

playFootsteps(runDuration);

await new Sequence()

.animation()

.on(sourceToken)

.moveTowards(originalPos)

.duration(runDuration)

.snapToGrid()

.play();

// --- DEBUG: after return Sequence completes -----------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI AttackDemo] Return Sequence complete for",

sourceToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- 3.5) Pause on home tile before flipping back to idle facing --------

if (flipBackDelay > 0) {

await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, flipBackDelay));

}

// --- 4) Instant flip again to restore original facing -------------------

await flipTokenInstant(sourceToken);

// --- Broadcast: Animation END (LOCAL ONLY) ------------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "meleeAttack",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenId: targetToken.id,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- DEBUG: macro end ----------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI AttackDemo] END",

"source:", sourceToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

})();
